theme_strategy: Industrial Enterprise Dashboard. Navy blue (#1E3A8A) header with a crisp light gray workspace. Focus on clarity, data density, and technical authority.

rules: Use Chivo for high-level module names and dashboard headers (e.g., 'Tenant Admin Dashboard').
Use IBM Plex Sans for tables, body text, forms, and secondary text.
Use IBM Plex Mono (or tabular lining in Plex Sans) for ALL live telemetry data, KPIs, and numbers to ensure alignment when values fluctuate.
Overlines and labels must be uppercase, tracking-[0.1em], and text-xs.

surfaces: Cards: Flat white background (#FFFFFF), crisp 1px border (#E2E8F0), no shadow by default, subtle shadow-sm on hover.
Header: Solid Navy Blue (#1E3A8A) with a hard bottom border or slight drop shadow.
visual_enhancers.status_pills: Capsule shape (rounded-full), distinct text, background, and border colors (1px). Include a small filled circle (dot) indicator inside the pill before the text for extra visual anchor.

login.left_panel: Illustration background with an overlay (bg-blue-900/40), brand typography 'CoreOT™', tagline 'Connect. Analyze. Transform. Automate. Humanize.'
login.right_panel: Clean white card form centered. Fields: Tenant/Company dropdown, Username, Password, Remember me, Forgot password, Sign In button. Footer: 'Secure. Scalable. Smart.'

dashboard.structure: Top Header (Navy Blue) + Left Sidebar (White) + Main Workspace (Light Gray).
dashboard.grid: Use High Density Grid (Bento Grid Protocol - Mode B).
dashboard.spacing: Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Utilize all pixels. 16px to 24px padding within cards.

layouts.asset_list: Full-width table layout, filters bar at the top, pagination at the bottom.
layouts.asset_360: Grid structure for live telemetry. Top row: Key status/health. Middle: Live charts (Recharts) and Gauge charts. Bottom: Telemetry cards (Vibration, Temp, RPM, etc.).

motion.telemetry: Apply a brief, subtle highlight (e.g., bg-blue-50 transition) on telemetry values when they update via WebSocket. Use Framer Motion for smooth number transitions.
motion.status_changes: Status dot indicator should 'pulse' (ping animation) when in WARNING or CRITICAL state.
motion.interactions: Hover states on all buttons and table rows (e.g., hover:bg-slate-50). Ensure text contrast meets standards during interaction.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML/Tailwind for structural layouts to ensure maximum customization.
Use Shadcn UI for complex interactives (Select, Table, DropdownMenu, Tabs).
Do NOT use HTML `<select>` or `<input type='date'>`. Use Shadcn variants.
For charts, use Recharts (or Shadcn Chart wrappers). Ensure charts use the industrial color palette and are readable.
Ensure all status badges use the color tokens defined in the guidelines.
Asset Hierarchy should be implemented as a recursive Tree view component with expandable/collapsible nodes.
KPI Cards must include the primary metric (large, IBM Plex Mono) and a secondary delta indicator (e.g., % change).

accessibility.contrast: Maintain WCAG AA (4.5:1 for standard text).
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have clear focus rings (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:outline-none).
accessibility.data_testid: Add data-testid attributes to all key elements (e.g., data-testid='tenant-selector', data-testid='login-button', data-testid='asset-health-badge').

images.description: Industrial architectural building in blue tones
images.category: Login screen left panel background illustration

media.icons: Use lucide-react for all icons (Dashboard, Assets, Users, Alarms, etc.). Provide consistent stroke-width (1.5 or 2).

libraries.charts: Recharts (LineChart for Alarms Trend, BarChart for Assets by Area, PieChart for Asset Health).
libraries.motion: framer-motion (for telemetry value updates and pulses)

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not center-align the app container. No generic `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Apply layered design elements for depth, but keep it clean (industrial style, not consumer app).
Never apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Target specific properties.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or floating menus. Always use solid white or gray with borders and shadow.
Always include `data-testid` on all interactive and informational elements.
